command:
set -u
restore_hardening() {
  mount -o remount,rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec /tmp >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  mount -o remount,rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec /dev/shm >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  rm -f /tmp/.mount_exec_test /tmp/.mount_dev_test /tmp/.mount_suid_test /dev/shm/.mount_exec_test /dev/shm/.mount_dev_test /dev/shm/.mount_suid_test
}
trap restore_hardening EXIT HUP INT TERM
failed=0
for mp in /tmp /dev/shm; do
  printf '#!/bin/sh\nexit 0\n' > "$mp/.mount_exec_test"
  chmod 755 "$mp/.mount_exec_test"
  "$mp/.mount_exec_test" >/dev/null 2>&1
  rc=$?
  printf '%s direct_exec_rc=%s (nonzero expected)\n' "$mp" "$rc"
  [ "$rc" -ne 0 ] || failed=1

  mknod "$mp/.mount_dev_test" c 1 3
  head -c 1 "$mp/.mount_dev_test" >/dev/null 2>&1
  rc=$?
  printf '%s device_open_rc=%s (nonzero expected)\n' "$mp" "$rc"
  [ "$rc" -ne 0 ] || failed=1

  cp /usr/bin/id "$mp/.mount_suid_test"
  chown root:root "$mp/.mount_suid_test"
  chmod 4755 "$mp/.mount_suid_test"
  mount -o remount,rw,nosuid,nodev,exec "$mp"
  uid_out=$(runuser -u nobody -- "$mp/.mount_suid_test" -u 2>&1)
  rc=$?
  printf '%s setuid_exec_rc=%s effective_uid=%s (nonroot expected)\n' "$mp" "$rc" "$uid_out"
  [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && [ "$uid_out" != 0 ] || failed=1
  mount -o remount,rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec "$mp"
done
restore_hardening
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
printf '%s\n' '--- final live options ---'
findmnt -T /tmp -no TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS
findmnt -T /dev/shm -no TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS
exit "$failed"
